## bash: network

| Script | What it does | When to use | Safety |
|---|---|---|---|
| [ssh-check.sh](scripts/ssh-check-bash.md) | Test SSH (TCP 22) reachability of network devices, filtered by client and device type. | Before or after a network change window, to confirm which switches, routers and firewalls answer. | Read-only (opens a TCP connection, sends no data) |

## PowerShell: active-directory

| Script | What it does | When to use | Safety |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Backup-GroupPolicy](scripts/Backup-GroupPolicy.md) | Backs up all (or selected) Group Policy Objects and writes an HTML backup report. | Before changing GPOs, before a domain migration, or as a scheduled safety copy of all policies. | Read-only |
| [Compare-ADUserGroupMembership](scripts/Compare-ADUserGroupMembership.md) | Compares AD group membership between a source user and one or more destination users, and optionally syncs it. | Onboarding a user like an existing one, checking access drift between role-mates, or access reviews. | Read-only by default. AddOnly/RemoveOnly/Mirror change group membership (supports -WhatIf and prompts to confirm) |
| [Export-ADServerList](scripts/Export-ADServerList.md) | Exports enabled Windows Server computer accounts from AD as a CSV for Devolutions RDM. | Onboarding a new customer into your RDM, or refreshing server entries after changes. | Read-only |
| [Export-ADUserReport](scripts/Export-ADUserReport.md) | Exports every Active Directory user with ~55 properties to a CSV. | Before a domain migration or cleanup, for access reviews, or to hand a customer a user list. | Read-only |
| [Export-OUStructure](scripts/Export-OUStructure.md) | Documents the OU hierarchy with object counts and GPO inheritance state as an HTML report (optional CSV). | Documenting an unfamiliar environment, planning a GPO or delegation redesign, or before an OU cleanup. | Read-only |
| [Get-ADGroupMembershipReport](scripts/Get-ADGroupMembershipReport.md) | Audits Active Directory group membership and writes an HTML report (optional CSV). | Access reviews, audits of who is in which security group, or before cleaning up groups. | Read-only |
| [Get-ADUserLogonComputer](scripts/Get-ADUserLogonComputer.md) | Finds which computers a user has authenticated from, using domain controller Security logs. | Investigating an account lockout source, a suspected compromised account, or "where is this user logged in". | Read-only |
| [Get-PasswordPolicyReport](scripts/Get-PasswordPolicyReport.md) | Reports the domain password policy and, optionally, per-user password compliance as HTML (optional CSV). | Security assessments, audit evidence for password policy, or finding accounts with expired or never-expiring passwords. | Read-only |
| [Get-PrivilegedGroupChange](scripts/Get-PrivilegedGroupChange.md) | Reports membership of privileged AD groups and detects additions/removals against a saved baseline. | Scheduled monitoring for unexpected additions to Domain Admins and other privileged groups, or a point-in-time privileged access review. | Changes data (supports -WhatIf) |
| [Remove-StaleADComputer](scripts/Remove-StaleADComputer.md) | Finds Windows computer accounts that have not logged on recently and optionally disables or deletes them. | Periodic AD hygiene, after decommissioning projects, or before a domain audit to clear out dead computer objects. | Destructive (supports -WhatIf) |
| [Test-DomainHealth](scripts/Test-DomainHealth.md) | Runs health checks against every domain controller and writes an HTML report. | Start of an engagement, after a DC migration or outage, or as a routine domain health check. | Read-only |

## PowerShell: azure

| Script | What it does | When to use | Safety |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Get-AzureNsgRiskReport](scripts/Get-AzureNsgRiskReport.md) | Audits Azure network security group (NSG) rules for overly permissive access and rates each rule. | Security review of a new customer tenant, before a pen test, or to find RDP/SSH/any-any rules open to the Internet. | Read-only |
| [Get-AzureRbacReport](scripts/Get-AzureRbacReport.md) | Reports privileged Azure RBAC role assignments (Owner, Contributor, User Access Administrator) per subscription and resource group. | Access review of a customer subscription, before removing standing Owner rights, or to list who can grant access. | Read-only |
| [Get-AzureSubscriptionReport](scripts/Get-AzureSubscriptionReport.md) | Produces a per-subscription overview of resource counts, resource groups and privileged role assignments. | First look at an unfamiliar tenant, to size an engagement, or to find empty or disabled subscriptions. | Read-only |
| [Get-AzureVMInventory](scripts/Get-AzureVMInventory.md) | Inventories Azure virtual machines across subscriptions with an estimated monthly and annual cost. | Cloud estate discovery, right-sizing conversations, or finding stopped-but-not-deallocated VMs before a cost review. | Read-only |
| [Set-AzureResourceTag](scripts/Set-AzureResourceTag.md) | Audits Azure resources for required tags and optionally adds the missing ones with a default value. | Tag governance clean-up before a cost-allocation exercise or policy rollout; run without -ApplyTags first and review the report. | Changes data (supports -WhatIf) |
| [Set-AzureVMAutoShutdown](scripts/Set-AzureVMAutoShutdown.md) | Finds Azure VMs without a DevTest auto-shutdown schedule and optionally applies one. | Cost control for dev/test subscriptions where VMs are left running overnight; run read-only first, then apply with -WhatIf before the real run. | Changes data (supports -WhatIf) |
| [Test-AzureBackupCompliance](scripts/Test-AzureBackupCompliance.md) | Checks which Azure VMs are protected by Azure Backup (Recovery Services vaults). | Disaster-recovery readiness review, or to prove backup coverage to an auditor or customer. | Read-only |
| [Test-AzureStorageExposure](scripts/Test-AzureStorageExposure.md) | Checks Azure storage accounts for public exposure and weak transport/network settings. | Security assessment, after a data-exposure scare, or before a compliance audit to find storage accounts open to the Internet. | Read-only |
| [Test-EntraConnectHealth](scripts/Test-EntraConnectHealth.md) | Runs basic Azure/Entra connectivity checks and reports whether on-premises directory sync (Entra Connect) is enabled. | First-pass check of a hybrid tenant before a migration or when users report that on-premises changes are not syncing. | Read-only |

| Script | What it does | When to use | Safety |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Get-OfficeVersionInventory](scripts/Get-OfficeVersionInventory.md) | Inventories the Microsoft Office Click-to-Run version on remote Windows computers. | Checking Office update channels/versions before a patching or licensing project. | Read-only |

## PowerShell: exchange

| Script | What it does | When to use | Safety |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Get-MailboxForwardingRule](scripts/Get-MailboxForwardingRule.md) | Finds mailbox-level forwarding and inbox-rule forwarding/redirects, and can optionally remove them. | After a suspected account compromise, during a security review, or before offboarding to find mail leaving the tenant. | Changes data (supports -WhatIf) |
| [Get-MailboxPermissionReport](scripts/Get-MailboxPermissionReport.md) | Reports who has FullAccess, SendAs and SendOnBehalf permissions on Exchange Online mailboxes. | Access reviews, offboarding checks, or investigating who can read or send as a sensitive mailbox. | Read-only |
| [Get-MailboxSizeReport](scripts/Get-MailboxSizeReport.md) | Reports Exchange Online mailbox sizes (and optionally archive sizes) with warning and critical thresholds. | Capacity planning, finding mailboxes near quota, or sizing a migration or archive rollout. | Read-only |
| [Get-SuspiciousInboxRule](scripts/Get-SuspiciousInboxRule.md) | Finds inbox rules that look like mail exfiltration or hiding activity (forward/redirect, delete, keywords, bad domains). | After a phishing or business-email-compromise incident, or as a periodic sweep for attacker-created inbox rules. | Read-only |
| [Invoke-TransportRuleTransfer](scripts/Invoke-TransportRuleTransfer.md) | Exports Exchange Online transport rules to an XML file, or imports (recreates) them from a previous export. | Backing up transport rules before changes, or copying rules from one tenant (for example a migration source) to another. | Changes data (supports -WhatIf) |
| [New-SharedMailboxFromCsv](scripts/New-SharedMailboxFromCsv.md) | Creates Exchange Online shared mailboxes in bulk from a CSV and optionally grants delegate permissions. | Provisioning many shared mailboxes at once, for example during onboarding or a tenant migration. | Changes data (supports -WhatIf) |
| [Set-MailboxLitigationHold](scripts/Set-MailboxLitigationHold.md) | Reports, enables or disables Litigation Hold on Exchange Online mailboxes. | Placing custodian mailboxes on hold for legal or compliance requests, or auditing which mailboxes are on hold before offboarding. | Destructive (supports -WhatIf) |

## PowerShell: m365

| Script | What it does | When to use | Safety |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Get-ConditionalAccessReport](scripts/Get-ConditionalAccessReport.md) | Audits Microsoft Entra Conditional Access policies and flags weak or misconfigured ones. | Security assessment of a new tenant, or before and after changing Conditional Access to find gaps such as missing MFA or lockout risk. | Read-only |
| [Get-GuestAccountReport](scripts/Get-GuestAccountReport.md) | Audits Entra ID (Azure AD) guest accounts and optionally blocks or removes stale ones. | Quarterly external-access review, or before cleaning up guests left behind by finished projects. | Destructive (supports -WhatIf) |
| [Get-LicenseUsageReport](scripts/Get-LicenseUsageReport.md) | Reports Microsoft 365 license inventory, utilization, estimated cost and inactive license holders. | Before a license true-up or renewal, or to find paid licenses held by users who no longer sign in. | Read-only |
| [Get-MfaStatusReport](scripts/Get-MfaStatusReport.md) | Reports per-user MFA registration and Conditional Access MFA coverage for the tenant. | Before enforcing MFA, during a security assessment, or to prove MFA coverage to an auditor. | Read-only |
| [Get-PrivilegedRoleReport](scripts/Get-PrivilegedRoleReport.md) | Audits who holds privileged Entra ID (Azure AD) directory roles, permanent and optionally PIM-eligible. | Access reviews, security assessments, or before cutting down the number of Global Administrators. | Read-only |
| [Get-RiskySignInReport](scripts/Get-RiskySignInReport.md) | Reports Entra ID Protection risk detections for a recent time window. | After a suspected account compromise, or as a routine weekly review of risky sign-ins. | Read-only |
| [Get-SecureScoreReport](scripts/Get-SecureScoreReport.md) | Reports the tenant's current Microsoft Secure Score, optionally with a per-control and per-category breakdown. | Security posture review, baseline before a hardening project, or quarterly progress reporting. | Read-only |
| [Get-StaleUserAccount](scripts/Get-StaleUserAccount.md) | Finds Entra ID (Azure AD) users who have not signed in recently and can optionally disable them. | Quarterly access review, license cleanup, or before an offboarding sweep. | Changes data (supports -WhatIf) |
| [Invoke-M365SecurityBaseline](scripts/Invoke-M365SecurityBaseline.md) | Runs a Microsoft 365 tenant security baseline audit (Tegria or CIS) and produces an HTML report with a score. | Onboarding a new customer, an annual security review, or before and after a remediation project. | Read-only |
| [Invoke-UserOffboarding](scripts/Invoke-UserOffboarding.md) | Bulk offboards Microsoft 365 users: blocks sign-in and optionally revokes sessions, removes licenses, converts the mailbox to shared and sets forwarding. | Departing employees or contractors, when access must be cut off and the mailbox preserved. | Destructive (supports -WhatIf) |
| [Invoke-UserOnboarding](scripts/Invoke-UserOnboarding.md) | Bulk creates Microsoft 365 (Entra ID) cloud users from a CSV, adds them to groups and assigns a license. | Starting a batch of new employees or a new customer tenant's initial users. | Changes data (supports -WhatIf) |

| Script | What it does | When to use | Safety |

## PowerShell: server

| Script | What it does | When to use | Safety |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Get-DiskSpaceStatus](scripts/Get-DiskSpaceStatus.md) | Monitors disk space on Windows systems and sends alerts when free space falls below a configurable threshold. | Scheduled daily check on a server to catch volumes running low before they fill, or an ad-hoc free-space check during an incident. | Changes data (supports -WhatIf) |
| [Get-DiskUsageAudit](scripts/Get-DiskUsageAudit.md) | Finds the largest files and duplicate files under a local or UNC path (audit only). | A volume is filling up and you need to see what is taking space, or to find duplicate data before a migration. | Read-only |
| [Get-EventLogAnomaly](scripts/Get-EventLogAnomaly.md) | Windows Event Log Anomaly Parser - detects critical errors and behavioral anomalies across System, Application, and Security logs on local or remote machines. | After an unexpected reboot, crash or slowdown, or as a routine check for repeated errors, bursts and failed logons across servers. | Read-only |
| [Get-FileServerPermissionReport](scripts/Get-FileServerPermissionReport.md) | Audits NTFS permissions on one or more folder trees and writes an HTML report (optional CSV). | Access reviews, tracking down who has FullControl or explicit Deny on a share, or before a file server migration. | Read-only |
| [Get-HyperVInventory](scripts/Get-HyperVInventory.md) | Inventories virtual machines on one or more Hyper-V hosts and writes an HTML report (optional CSV). | Capacity planning, documenting a customer's virtual estate, or finding VMs with forgotten snapshots before maintenance. | Read-only |
| [Get-PatchComplianceReport](scripts/Get-PatchComplianceReport.md) | Reports Windows Update patch compliance for one or more servers as an HTML report (optional CSV). | Monthly patch review, before a maintenance window, or to show a customer which servers have fallen behind on updates. | Read-only |
| [Start-SqlServiceMonitor](scripts/Start-SqlServiceMonitor.md) | Ensures all SQL Server services are running. Retries for 30 seconds and alerts if any fail to start. | After patching or reboots, or as a scheduled task, to bring SQL services back up and raise an alert if they won't start. | Changes data (starts stopped services; supports -WhatIf) |
| [Test-BackupStatus](scripts/Test-BackupStatus.md) | Verifies that backups are recent: Windows Server Backup sets and/or the newest file in backup folders. | Daily or weekly backup verification, or to confirm a customer's backups are actually landing before a change window. | Read-only |
| [Test-ServiceHealth](scripts/Test-ServiceHealth.md) | Checks that key Windows services are running on one or more servers and reports the result as HTML (optional CSV). | After patching or a reboot to confirm services came back, or as a routine health check on application and infrastructure servers. | Read-only |
